QuestInfo.name: [Eluna Express] Aliens in Glass Starships
QuestInfo.0: End your duel with Von Leon and find Eremos, so you can talk with him.
QuestInfo.1: Eremos is happy that you punished Von Leon, but Surana is clearly upset. Must justice come at any cost, or is there a time and a place for mercy? The argument grows heated, and Surana storms off the ship.
